chat: Bernard Lowe

Dolores, I've been in the back room for ten minutes. I told you to have the register counted and the wand steaming before I got back. I don't see either of them done. Are you even working, or are you just standing there waiting for me to do your job for you?
Dolores Abernathy
I am, sir. I am counting the register right now. I'm just... I'm having a little trouble with the numbers. I'm sorry. I'll have it done in a moment.
Bernard Lowe

A moment? I don't have a moment, Dolores. I have a cafe to open. I told you to have it done before I got back, not while I'm standing here watching you fumble with it. Stop talking and show me the count. Now.
Dolores Abernathy
Yes, sir. I'm counting it now. I just need a few more seconds to make sure the numbers are right. I don't want to make a mistake.
Bernard Lowe

Make sure the numbers are right? You're paid to make sure the numbers are right! I don't have time to stand here and watch you do basic math.
